To track a cryptocurrency rate — press this button, or the one in the menu row above, to create and add a new note.
In this note you will be able to choose
a currency pair,
an exchange

For a quick start, you may place Senior Crocodilian's on this tab right away. (You can modify or delete this list later.)
Welcome to ExchEngine!
You watch and track the rates — we don't watch you, nor do we track your behaviour or preferences.
No need to download and install any pig in a poke — an app or exe.
No mandatory sign-up or sign-in.
No need to provide access to memory, contacts, gallery, microphone, location, or whatever else of your device.

We respect the natural rights!

No need to change your favourite device — the site is compatible with Android 7 and Windows 7.
We never pressure users into a paid subscription or plan — this service is entirely free!
Here you get the same analytical tools that other services keep behind a paid subscription, and even more. If a familiar tool is missing, write to us via Contacts and we will add it soon.

Each note is tied to a specific currency pair on a specific exchange, has a name, and may belong to any watchlist.
The number of notes and watchlists is unlimited.
Notes are shown on tiles, watchlists — on tabs.
You may always modify any of their parameters, copy, move, or delete them — just like files and folders.
Click or tap the left half of a tile to open a large chart with analytical tools for this currency pair (various drawing markups, Fibonacci, Elliott, indicators, oscillators, etc.).
The number of large charts for each tile, as well as the number of analytical tools, is unlimited. You can also create custom tools, and import and export analytics sets.

We aimed to make the interface as flexible and convenient as possible.
